rows.title: Pipe Welding with SMAW (5G)
rows.heading: STUDENT LEARNING OUTCOMES
outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to interpret pipe welding symbols.
Evaluate what level of personal protective equipment (PPE) is required for SMAW pipe welding.
Be able to set-up machine for 5G
objectives: Assemble SMAW equipment for open-root V-groove pipe welds.
Able to interpret welding symbols for groove welds
Able to safely use beveling equipment, including hand grinder
Evaluate and apply the appropriate level of PPE needed for pipe welding and related tasks.
Minimize the number of defects.
Able to calculate pipe off sets.
Able to set-up for 5G pipe fixturing and welding equipment.
Able to visually inspect welds for defects.
